from collections import Counter

def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = min((x for x in counts if x != bg), key=lambda x: -counts[x])
    markers = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == marker]
    template = [(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg, marker)]
    rmin, rmax = min(r for r,c,v in template), max(r for r,c,v in template)
    cmin, cmax = min(c for r,c,v in template), max(c for r,c,v in template)
    ar, ac = (rmin+rmax)//2, (cmin+cmax)//2
    obj = [(r-ar,c-ac,v) for r,c,v in template]
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in markers:
        for dr,dc,v in obj:
            rr,cc = r+dr,c+dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = v
    return out
